correctness.rationale: The coefficient identity follows by expanding the exponential of the Carathéodory logarithmic derivative; the two-step Schur parametrization represents all admissible coefficient triples including non-inner maps. At beta=0 the sharp triangle/Schur estimate is 1/8 with a unique normalized optimizer. The modulus outward radial derivative at the optimizer stays uniformly at least 3/32 over the remaining Schur parameter; compactness forces inner |x|=1 for all nearby angles. The boundary Hessian -1/9, -3/512 is negative definite, and the exact angular cross derivative -5/768 gives phase slope -10/9. The implicit-function/envelope argument proves M=1/8-59 beta²/432+O(beta⁴), even in beta. An explicit admissible finite Blaschke witness attains that leading term and exceeds the quoted B by 41 beta²/864+O(beta⁴). Exact SymPy differentiation was executed on the included verification script; finite numerical output is only a sanity check. No global-univalence claim is used.
